D5/S3/Observer/Conditioning.IsRecordMeas.name: D5.S3.Observer.Conditioning.IsRecordMeasurement
D5/S3/Observer/Conditioning.IsRecordMeas.signature: structure IsRecordMeasurement (P : kappa -> Matrix n n ℂ) : Prop where selfAdjoint : forall k, star (P k) = P k idempotent : forall k, P k * P k = P k orthogonal : forall k l, k ≠ l -> P k * P l = 0 complete : ∑ k, P k = 1 /-- The state obtained by measuring the record and then discarding its value. -/ def unreadState (P : kappa -> Matrix n n ℂ) (rho : Matrix n n ℂ) : Matrix n n ℂ

D5/S3/Observer/Conditioning.conditionalS.signature: theorem conditionalState_isState (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P) {rho : Matrix n n ℂ} (hRho : rho.PosSemidef) (hTr : Matrix.trace rho = 1) {k : kappa} (hk : recordWeight P rho k ≠ 0) : (conditionalState P rho k).PosSemidef /\ Matrix.trace (conditionalState P rho k) = 1

D5/S3/Observer/Conditioning.unreadState_.name: D5.S3.Observer.Conditioning.unreadState_fixed_iff
D5/S3/Observer/Conditioning.unreadState_.signature: theorem unreadState_fixed_iff (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P) (rho : Matrix n n ℂ) : unreadState P rho = rho <-> forall k l, k ≠ l -> P k * rho * P l = 0

D5/S3/Observer/Conditioning/FiniteRecord.signature: theorem finite_record_pinching_idempotent {n kappa : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype kappa] (P : kappa -> Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P) : Function.comp (unreadState P) (unreadState P) = unreadState P

D5/S3/Observer/Conditioning/RankOneBornP.signature: theorem rank_one_born_pairing_weight {n kappa : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype kappa] (P : kappa -> Matrix n n ℂ) (rho : Matrix n n ℂ) (k : kappa) (phi psi : n -> ℂ) (hP : IsRecordMeasurement P) (hState : rho.PosSemidef ∧ Matrix.trace rho = 1) (hProjection : P k = Matrix.vecMulVec phi (star phi)) (hPureState : rho = Matrix.vecMulVec psi (star psi)) : recordWeight P rho k = ((‖star phi ⬝ᵥ psi‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧ recordWeight P rho k = Matrix.trace (rho * P k) ∧ unreadState P rho = ∑ j, recordWeight P rho j • conditionalState P rho j

D5/S3/Quantum/FiniteDimensional.born_pro.signature: theorem born_probability_skeleton {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (rho : Matrix n n ℂ) (hRho : rho.PosSemidef) (hTrace : Matrix.trace rho = 1) : bornProbability rho (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 ∧ (∀ P Q : Matrix n n ℂ, bornProbability rho (P + Q) = bornProbability rho P + bornProbability rho Q) ∧ ∀ P : Matrix n n ℂ, star P = P → P * P = P → 0 ≤ bornProbability rho P

D5/S3/QuantumChannels/CoherenceMassBridg.signature: theorem pinching_discarded_mass_eq_zero_iff (rho : QubitMatrix) : hilbertSchmidtInner (rho - pinching rho) (rho - pinching rho) = 0 ↔ offDiag rho = 0

D5/S3/QuantumChannels/CoherenceMassBridg.signature: theorem pinching_eq_self_iff_offDiag_eq_zero (rho : QubitMatrix) : pinching rho = rho ↔ offDiag rho = 0

D5/S3/QuantumChannels/PinchingProjection.signature: theorem pinching_discarded_coherence_mass (rho : QubitMatrix) : hilbertSchmidtInner (rho - pinching rho) (rho - pinching rho) = Complex.normSq (rho 0 1) + Complex.normSq (rho 1 0)

D5/S3/QuantumChannels/PinchingProjection.name: D5.S3.QuantumChannels.PinchingProjection.pinching_hilbert_schmidt_pythagorean
D5/S3/QuantumChannels/PinchingProjection.signature: theorem pinching_hilbert_schmidt_pythagorean (rho : QubitMatrix) : hilbertSchmidtInner rho rho = hilbertSchmidtInner (pinching rho) (pinching rho) + hilbertSchmidtInner (rho - pinching rho) (rho - pinching rho)

D5/S3/QuantumContext/ParallelogramNormLa.name: D5.S3.QuantumContext.ParallelogramNormLaw.inner_product_norm_parallelogram_law
D5/S3/QuantumContext/ParallelogramNormLa.signature: theorem inner_product_norm_parallelogram_law {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (x y : E) : ‖x + y‖ ^ 2 + ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2)
